title: Changed-files format

request.details: Under ## Changed Files or the Korean heading, list one repository-relative path per bullet. Use forward slashes. Include created, modified and deleted files. For a rename use the resulting path. The maximum is 200 entries.

response: The server compares the list with actual workspace changes.
errors: On mismatch or scope refusal check for missing or extra paths and verify the heading. Use an unnumbered heading and relative paths without dot segments.
